description:
An open-source, clean-room spreadsheet reimplementation of Microsoft Excel, rebuilt in pure Rust

GridCraft is a fast, open-source, clean-room reimplementation of the Microsoft Excel workflow, rebuilt in pure Rust. One Rust codebase runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux and BSD, and in the browser via WebAssembly, with no subscription, no licence server and no telemetry.

- Familiar: Excel's ribbon, formula bar, Name Box, sheet tabs, keyboard shortcuts, fill handle, point-mode formula entry with coloured references, Format Cells, Paste Special, conditional formatting, tables, charts and more.
- Compatible: XLSX is the native format; styles, themes, formulas including dynamic arrays, tables, conditional formats, validation, comments, hyperlinks, charts, pictures, sparklines, PivotTables and print settings round-trip. CSV and TSV too.
- Capable: a dependency-graph calculation engine with dynamic arrays and spilling, 500+ worksheet functions plus LET, LAMBDA, MAP, REDUCE, SCAN, BYROW, BYCOL and MAKEARRAY, structured table references, Excel's full number-format language, sort and AutoFilter, Flash Fill, data validation, outlining and subtotals.
- Charts and PivotTables: seventeen chart types with a Chart Design tab and Format pane, and PivotTables with field list, filters, layouts, date grouping and show-values-as, saved to and read from XLSX.
- Fast: copy-on-write workbooks where undo snapshots are nearly free, incremental recalculation, and a virtualised grid that only lays out what is on screen.
- Agent-native: every ribbon button, menu item, dialog, keystroke and mouse gesture is a command that agents can run over a JSON control channel, an MCP server or the CLI.
What's Changed
- Data: Solver Load/Save Model and Reset All by @prxnvt in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3086
- Data: Solver Options by @prxnvt in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3087
- M7: add data tables beneath charts by @campbellcody in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3123
- Page Layout: Page Setup's page order (Down, then over / Over, then down) by @iluebbe in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3130
- Formulas: Trace Error draws arrows back to the cell an error starts in by @iluebbe in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3133
- Clip whole-column chart sources to the used range by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3135
- Data: Analysis ToolPak two-factor Anova, z-Test, Fourier Analysis, Random Number Generation and Sampling by @prxnvt in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/495
- UI: an unsaved macro-editor draft counts as unsaved work when its workbook closes by @prxnvt in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/492
- Objects: one selection for every floating object, eight resize handles, and objects that follow edits by @prxnvt in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/470
- Data: Solver Sensitivity report by @prxnvt in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/501
- fix(ui): show shortcuts in command palette (#2725) by @AnhNgoo in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2729
- Equations: Insert › Equation with a LaTeX editor, Office Math in xlsx and equations in PDF by @prxnvt in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/471
- Python cells as data: stored, edited and saved as Excel's PY formula (no code runs) by @prxnvt in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2637
- Python cells in the interface: formula bar Python mode and the output switch (no code runs) by @prxnvt in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/2639
- Restore GNOME Wayland window controls without bundled fonts by @danielmigueltejedor in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/1576
- UI: RefEdit reference boxes in dialogs (Goal Seek, Solver, Data Analysis) by @prxnvt in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/494
